assumptions: All families use equal nominal copper area, fixed physical strand IDs, SI coordinates and 1 m axial length.
Hamilton geometry is a noncrossing adjacent square-grid closed cycle; all strands move one directed edge simultaneously using 10t^3-15t^4+6t^5, then repeat for N steps.
Two-level examples use 2x2 strand subbundles, inner relative pitch P/4, and a whole-bundle pitch P; they are explicit traditional baselines, not claimed industrial optima.
Continuous 3D clearance is certified by analytic same-z separation and a global transverse Lipschitz bound, not by same-z sampling alone.
Curvature is bounded from analytic second derivatives; sampled CSV polylines and previews are illustrations, not manufacturing solids.
Radial residence and angular moments are geometric histories. They do not prove electromagnetic equality, manufacturability on a particular machine, thermal compliance, or a loss ranking.
The copper-only gap threshold has no specified polyurethane thickness, tension or fatigue model; certificates apply to nominal circular tubes only.
Rac, Rac/Rdc, loss and solved strand currents require a field/circuit run and are intentionally absent.
